seeds.title: janitor accepts a whitespace format without a note
seeds.detail: janitor.py checks the format with branches.split only, not validate_format. A format such as 'a b/{name}' gives no note. It deletes nothing, because git refuses such branch names.

seeds.title: janitor docstring summary line is stale
seeds.detail: The first line still says 'leftover slice branches'. The sweep now deletes verify branches only.
